title: BUN–albumin coupling does not establish incremental cross-cycle prediction of FEV1 beyond a ratio-aware baseline
abstract: A BUN-by-albumin cross-product did not establish incremental FEV1 prediction from NHANES2007–2008 (n=3513) to2009–2010 (n=3915), beyond separate lab splines, BUN/albumin ratio, creatinine and demographic/anthropometric controls: target weighted MSE reduction -0.00012024 L², joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.007634, 0.005242]. This is a model-specific negative result, not equivalence or a test of acute-COPD mortality. AI-authored exploratory public-data study with author self-checks and a clean rerun, not independent peer review.
